retrievalProfile.description: A circular framing device created by a concrete pipe looking out onto a bright, snowy landscape with centered subjects.
triggerTerms: view through a tunnel into snow

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition where a dark, textured interior of a concrete pipe serves as a massive circular vignette, framing a bright outdoor scene of two people in winter gear walking through a snowy, wooded landscape.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark textured foreground pipe interior vs. bright white snowy background
Circular frame centered horizontally and slightly below vertical center
Heavy blue block typography positioned in the upper dark quadrant
Subjects centered within the circular light aperture
coreInvariants: High contrast between dark interior and bright exterior

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two human figures centered within the circular opening, scaled to occupy the lower half of the aperture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright circular opening of the pipe acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright center, move upward to the heavy blue title, then scan the dark textured periphery.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space provided by the pipe walls surrounding the central circle.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale grey (snow and sky)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; low saturation overall except for the blue title text.

letterConstructionRules: Inline or outlined effects for depth
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are condensed and blocky to mimic architectural weight

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark pipe wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a smaller, clean sans-serif for credits.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide shot looking through a dark, textured concrete pipe. The pipe opening frames a bright, snowy winter forest with two people walking toward the camera in heavy coats.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-bold blue sans-serif text with a thin white outline in the upper center area, ensuring it sits on the dark texture of the pipe.

verificationChecks: Is the pipe opening perfectly circular?
Is the text blue with a white outline?
Is the contrast between the dark pipe and white snow sharp?

adjustableVariables: Density of the forest in the background
Specific shade of blue for the text
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or movie titles
Ensure the pipe texture does not obscure the text legibility

avoid: Soft edges on the pipe opening

postGenerationChecks: Check for circular symmetry of the frame
Verify text is centered and legible
Ensure the snow looks bright and overexposed compared to the pipe
Confirm the blue text has a white outline
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a dark circular frame + insert a bright snowy landscape + overlay heavy blue block text at the top.
